regime_context: The detector shows a dominant one-narrative structure in Canada/TSX: Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO) is the sole eligible leader with high durability (0.71) and broad participation (breadth 0.929), while most other themes are ineligible and the rotation breadth has narrowed to 0.38. The validated edge is drawdown/shake-out control via the absolute-trend gate (gate_helps=true) — not return forecasting; rank-IC on clean sectors is weak. Given the 0.324 directional accuracy in the track record, conviction must default low.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (XGD.TO, rank 2, score 1.015) is the nearest challenger but ineligible (durability 0.16) and has near-zero breadth (0.067). I am watching for Gold Miners to become eligible=true while holding breadth above 0.3 for 5 consecutive sessions — that would retire the watch by confirming a real leadership handoff rather than a one-day pop.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: The only eligible, scorable theme with durable leadership: high durability_bar (0.71), broad breadth (0.929), and the top rank/score. The absolute-trend gate flagging it eligible is the one validated risk-control leg — the staying-power signal, not a return forecast. Crowding (z=1.19, crowded=true) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. The one-narrative structure concentrates flow here.
evidence: gate_helps=true — absolute-trend gate is the validated leg
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is reflexive and crowded (z=1.19). In a resource-heavy benchmark the Oil & Gas theme is the beta proxy itself; a mean-reverting pullback in crude would hit the entire one-narrative complex first, and the detector's own rank-IC is ~0 — the leadership tells you about attention concentration, not future return.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO drops below its own 50-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Second eligible theme with a trend-qualified hurst_tag (trend) and moderate durability (0.63). It is the only other eligible, scorable, non-crowded theme, providing a defensive complement to the dominant energy leadership without competing for the same flow. The trend gate is the validated leg supporting staying power.
theses.dissent: Canadian banks are rate-sensitive and correlated with the broader TSX; if the dominant oil narrative unwinds and rates expectations shift, the banks' trend tag offers no insulation from a macro drawdown — and the detector's momentum rank carries no forward edge.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO underperforms XEG.TO by more than 4% cumulatively over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Crowded (z=1.36, crowded=true) and near-zero score (-0.037) with mixed hurst, despite eligible=true. The crowding flag is a size-down caution, and with one-narrative dominance in energy the technology theme offers no confirmed handoff or directional signal to act on. Avoid — not a fade or short, just no overweight lean.
theses.dissent: Technology breadth (0.8) is healthy and hurst is mixed, not mean-reverting; a surprise macro shock (unscheduled share 0.75) or AI narrative resurgence could draw flow back into defense/growth and break the one-narrative structure.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO closes above its score-implied rank position (i.e., prints a strong relative up-leg vs SPX/TSX) for 10 of 20 sessions before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
